service.name: Modern jazz trio
service.serviceType: Modern jazz guitar trio for cocktail hours, dinners, galas and private events
service.description: A Denver jazz guitar trio, Doug Emery, Sri Viswanath and Brian Jaffe, playing the standards with a modern edge as a trio or as a quartet with saxophone, for cocktail hours, dinners, galas, weddings and private events across Denver, the Front Range and the Colorado mountain corridor.

faqs.q: What does Changes Jazz Trio play?
faqs.a: Jazz standards, played by a Denver guitar trio with a modern edge: guitar, fretless bass and drums, with the arrangements left open. It's instrumental, so it sits under a dinner, and it holds a listening crowd when the evening gives it one. Their site carries two studio recordings.

faqs.q: How is this different from the jazz duo?
faqs.a: The jazz duo is upright bass and guitar playing standards for cocktails and dinner, with the musicians matched to your date. Changes is a working trio with drums and a fretless bass, a more modern sound, and three musicians you can look up before you book.

Under cocktails and dinner the trio plays at the level of the table's conversation, with the drums kept soft. A featured set with the saxophone is louder on purpose, because that's the part people stop to hear. If your venue has a sound limit, give us the number and the set is built under it.
Denver. All three musicians live and work in the Denver metro, and the trio plays the Front Range and the mountain towns.
Yes, with a covered, level and dry spot and power run to it. We agree a plan for moving indoors with you ahead of time, because Colorado evenings turn fast.
